title: MoE Ethiopian Exit Exam: Tourism and Hotel Management (2016)
description: Official Ministry of Education (MoE) Ethiopian University Exit Examination for Tourism and Hotel Management (2016). Complete with detailed explanations.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following statement is not true about human needs?
options: human need is a state of felt deprivation.
Needs are how humans communicate their wants.
Needs are the basic human requirements.
Air, food, water, clothing, and shelter to survive.
questions.explanation: Needs are not how humans communicate their wants; they are the basic human requirements. Wants are how people communicate their needs. Needs are states of felt deprivation.

questions.questionText: All are among the challenges of tourism industry, except:
questions.explanation: High rate of pay is not a challenge; it is generally considered a positive aspect.

questions.questionText: Which promotional mix do the organizers want to select?
questions.explanation: Public relations help build good relations and manage publicity.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a potential negative impact of tourism on host community?
questions.explanation: Overcrowding and strain on infrastructure are negative impacts of tourism on host communities. The other options (economic growth, preservation of cultural heritage, and promotion of sustainable practices) are generally considered positive impacts of tourism.

questions.questionText: From the 7Ps of marketing mix elements, which one is about the way we serve our customers?
questions.explanation: Process refers to the way services are delivered to customers.

questions.questionText: The first hotel in Ethiopia was?
questions.explanation: Taytu hotel is recognized as the first hotel in Ethiopia.

questions.questionText: __________ represents the value of the time and effort that a founder puts into a new venture.
questions.explanation: Sweat equity represents the non-monetary investment that founders put into their business in the form of time, skills, effort, and expertise. It acknowledges the value created by the founder's personal labor rather than financial investment.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is the first church on African soil?
questions.explanation: St. Mary of Zion Church in Axum is considered the first church on African soil, built in the 4th century AD during the reign of King Ezana.

questions.questionText: Mr. Kebede went to Sikomendo hotel and ordered a fruit pizza and one beer. However, the waitress told him to order a non-alcoholic drink since alcoholic drinks are not allowed to be served in the hotel. Mr. Kebede's demand could be categorized under:
questions.explanation: His demand falls under both unavailable service and demands against policies.

questions.questionText: Which principle of destination is concerning 'complete; useful; inclusive of several types of resources' in a destination?
questions.explanation: Integrity refers to the completeness and usefulness of a destination.

questions.questionText: What is inventory Control Management in food and Beverage Operation?
options: It is the process of enumerating the inventory that enters and leaves a facility, managing stock to avoid spoilage and losses.
It helps to determine how much product the firms should carry to reduce the total inventory costs.
It supports planning when to repurchase food and beverage ingredients.
It is the process of shipping out or using the oldest products first to avoid keeping products beyond expiration.
questions.explanation: Inventory Control Management involves managing stock to prevent spoilage and losses.

questions.questionText: All statements indicate the procedure of reducing frauds in a catering establishment except:
options: Buying too much or too little as they make beverage purchasing decisions.
While receiving goods writing down with proper financial, security consideration and the exact quantity and the right quality of product.
Verifying the products quality has to be and stored as per the respective area.
Every received product should be stored on the same shelf.
questions.explanation: Storing every received product on the same shelf does not help in reducing fraud.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following northern Stelae Park was shipped during the Italian Fascist invasion on the personal orders of the Italian dictator Mussolini in 1937?
questions.explanation: The Rome Stele (or Obelisk of Axum) was shipped to Rome during the Italian occupation in 1937 on Mussolini's orders. It was returned to Ethiopia in 2005.

questions.questionText: __________ is any person who creates and develops a business idea and takes the risk of setting up an enterprise to produce a product or service which satisfies customer needs.
questions.explanation: An entrepreneur is someone who creates and develops a business idea.

questions.questionText: From the functional management area which can contribute through promotion & development of sustainable tourism?
questions.explanation: All functional management areas can contribute to sustainable tourism.

questions.questionText: Which one is the Key components of the Tourism event industry?
options: Event venues, industry associations and external regulatory bodies.
questions.explanation: All listed options are key components of the tourism event industry.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is odd?
questions.explanation: Individual general business trips are different from the other options.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is among the sustainable tourism tools?
questions.explanation: All listed options are tools for sustainable tourism.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is an advantage of the tour bus, except?
options: The bus becomes the group's private world
The bus that tour guide develops the feeling of group individualism.
The bus members become well acquainted with each other
Buses allow you to have flexible schedules
questions.explanation: Tour buses typically follow fixed itineraries and schedules, which limits flexibility. The other options are all advantages of tour buses, including creating a private group space, fostering group cohesion, and facilitating social interactions among passengers.

questions.questionText: From the following indicates the types of guests which hotels tend to allow credit for them, except for____________?
options: Those whose accounts will be settled by their companies
Those who will settle their accounts by credit or charge cards.
questions.explanation: Hotels typically do not allow credit for non-guaranteed reservations.

questions.questionText: Which of the following natural characteristics and features of a destination can attract beach lovers, scuba divers, and snorkelers?
questions.explanation: Coastal and marine environments are specifically attractive to beach lovers and divers.

questions.questionText: One of the following organizations is established in 1944 by 52 nations?
questions.explanation: The International Civil Aviation Organization was established in 1944.

questions.questionText: Well planned strategy, innovative capacity and financial strength are good examples for:
questions.explanation: These factors represent internal strengths of a company in a SWOT analysis. Strengths are internal positive attributes that the company controls. Opportunities and threats are external factors, while weaknesses (not listed) are internal negative factors.

questions.questionText: Tactfulness:
questions.explanation: A tactful guide is sensitive to the needs and feelings of others.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is/are an example of Special-interest tours except?
questions.explanation: Indigenous sites tours are generally considered cultural or heritage tourism rather than special-interest tours. Photography, sporting, and educational tours are all recognized types of special-interest tourism.

questions.questionText: Among the following alternatives which one is incorrect about handling customer complaints in a good manner?
options: Ask them how you can make things right
questions.explanation: Arguing with customers is not a good practice in handling complaints.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is responsible for the tour manager in Meeting up on arrival time?
options: To meet and welcome them in a hospitable manner
Offer the required information about your tour company to the guests
questions.explanation: All listed responsibilities are part of a tour manager's duties.

questions.questionText: Among the following one is a type of customer which deals with the people and organizations who have a need for your product or service and purchase your stuff in exchange for money.
questions.explanation: External customers are those who purchase products or services.

questions.questionText: Making different public relations to raise the business of the hotel is the responsibility of?
questions.explanation: The marketing and sales department is responsible for public relations.

questions.questionText: Among the following statements which can indicate the difference between Travel Agencies and Tour Operators?
options: Tour operator is a company that buys certain services from different companies and forms a single tourist product out of them using its own pricing system. While travel agency sells tour operator's products to get commission.
tour operator may be a supplier (meaning they might own hotels or car rentals or both) and allow to use their own inventory or their supplying partner inventories for a fee.
travel agent is only a distributor, and typically travel agents rarely own any travel assets.
questions.explanation: All statements correctly describe the differences between travel agencies and tour operators.

questions.questionText: From the following statement one is odd regarding different ways food and beverage division manager employ to enhance revenue in the food service industry.
options: Appreciate customers to approach with other customers.
Deprive customers to come back or purchase more often.
Encourage customers to spend more while they are at the firm's.
questions.explanation: Depriving customers is not a strategy to enhance revenue.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is important to minimizing Difficult Situations?
options: Never criticize attack or comment in a negative manner
questions.explanation: All options are important for minimizing difficult situations.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following statements is not true about travel agency and tour operator?
options: Travel agency and tour operator are the Link between service provider and consumers.
Travel agency works for making profit while tour operation works for getting commission.
Tour operation buys the service from the service provider in bulky amount with discount price and makes the package or bundles of product then sells it to the consumers or retail travel agency.
Tour operation is the whole seller arms of the travel industry.
questions.explanation: The statement is false because both travel agencies and tour operators work for profit. However, travel agencies typically earn commissions from suppliers (including tour operators) while tour operators make profit from the markup on packages they create by bulk buying services.

questions.questionText: Among the following, one is benefits of business plan?
options: To assess the feasibility and viability of the business
questions.explanation: All options are benefits of having a business plan.

questions.questionText: An internet-based system used by hotels that allows hotel guests to check availability and make reservations at the hotel is called:
questions.explanation: Online reservation systems allow guests to check availability and book rooms.

questions.questionText: Buy used instead of new equipment, Coordinate purchases with other businesses & Lease equipment instead of buying are best examples of:
options: Financial source from Friends and Family
questions.explanation: These practices are examples of bootstrapping, which is a method of starting a business with minimal financial resources.

questions.questionText: All of the following are International organizations related to cultural tourism except:
questions.explanation: NALA (National Adult Literacy Agency) is not an international organization related to cultural tourism. UNESCO (United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization), ICOMOS (International Council on Monuments and Sites), and ICOM (International Council of Museums) are all international organizations involved in cultural heritage and tourism.

questions.questionText: From the following alternatives which is/are not true about service culture in hotel and tourism industry?
options: Focuses on serving and satisfying the customer
Give attention only for organization growth
Empowers employees to solve customer problems
questions.explanation: A service culture should focus on both customer satisfaction and organizational growth.

questions.questionText: __________ is the blueprint of the step-by-step procedure that would be followed to convert a business idea into a successful business venture.
questions.explanation: A business plan outlines the steps to turn an idea into a successful venture.

questions.questionText: Why is event evaluation predominantly the final stage of a tourism event and very essential?
options: It understands the overall performance of the event.
It identifies areas for future improvement.
Put relevant recommendations for the success of future events based on the current experience.
questions.explanation: Event evaluation is crucial for assessing performance and planning future improvements.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not true about the so-called 'periegetei'?
options: They can also be called 'exgetei' or explainer
Their function is to help fellow citizens to travel abroad
questions.explanation: The 'periegetei' in ancient Greece were not primarily concerned with helping fellow citizens travel abroad. They were local guides who showed visitors around sites and explained local customs, monuments, and history. The term does mean 'leader' in Greek, and they were also known as 'exegetai' (explainers).

questions.questionText: Why do some business plans fail?
options: The entrepreneur has no experience in the planned business
No customer need was established for the proposed product or service
questions.explanation: All listed reasons can contribute to the failure of a business plan.

questions.questionText: Among the most basic customer requirements which one is about customers need to feel that the service person recognizes and appreciates their circumstances and feelings without criticism?
questions.explanation: Understanding and empathy are crucial for customer satisfaction.

questions.questionText: What are the criteria a cultural property should have to get listed as a world heritage site (to be included under UNESCO)?
options: Exhibit an important exchange of human values over a span of time.
Should represent a masterpiece of human creative genius.
Significant ongoing ecological and biological process, such as those related to marine ecosystems and communities of animals and plants.
questions.explanation: Option C relates to natural heritage criteria, not cultural property criteria. Both options A and B are valid criteria for cultural properties to be listed as UNESCO World Heritage sites.

questions.questionText: All of the following are the main reasons when King Lalibela constructed the rock-hewn churches of Lalibela except?
options: To minimize the sufferings of Christian society in their journey to Jerusalem
To build the second Jerusalem on the African continent
To maximize the sufferings of Christian society in their journey to Jerusalem
questions.explanation: King Lalibela constructed the rock-hewn churches to create a 'New Jerusalem' in Ethiopia and to minimize the sufferings of Christians who couldn't make the dangerous pilgrimage to Jerusalem. The idea of maximizing suffering contradicts the historical purpose of these churches.

questions.questionText: Among the following which is/are the duties and responsibilities of the night auditor?
options: Reconciles all the financial transactions between a hotel and its guests.
Calculates the total revenue generated during the day.
Verifies and validates the cashier's posting of charges in the guest accounts.
questions.explanation: All listed tasks are responsibilities of the night auditor.

questions.questionText: In the hotel industry generally and front office specifically, what is the operation of the night auditor?
options: Track all the financial transactions between the hotel and its guests
Handling the luggage of the guests
questions.explanation: The night auditor tracks financial transactions.

questions.questionText: ______ is a type of Ethiopian hotel chain which controls all hotels in eastern Ethiopia?
questions.explanation: Wabe Shebelle hotel chains control hotels in eastern Ethiopia.

questions.questionText: Why is maturity an important quality of a tour guide?
questions.explanation: Maturity helps a tour guide in understanding and managing various situations.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is the correct sequential order of the Product Life Cycle?
options: Introduction, Product development, Growth, Maturity, Decline
Product development, Growth, Introduction, Maturity, Decline
Introduction, Growth, Product development, Maturity, Decline
Product development, Introduction, Growth, Maturity, Decline
questions.explanation: The correct order of the Product Life Cycle is: Product development, Introduction, Growth, Maturity, and Decline. Product development always comes first before the product is introduced to the market.

questions.questionText: From the following alternatives what other departments can do to help the credit department succeed in its job of credit monitoring?
options: The room-service cashiers should immediately alert the credit dept.
The room service waiter should report unusual activity
The maid indicates the status of the room in her morning report
questions.explanation: All departments can contribute to effective credit monitoring.

questions.questionText: A systematic & documented evaluation of the environmental performance on a regular basis is______________
questions.explanation: An Environmental Audit systematically evaluates environmental performance.

questions.questionText: All of the following are intangible cultural heritage resources of Ethiopia registered by UNESCO except.
questions.explanation: Gedeo cultural landscape is not registered as an intangible cultural heritage by UNESCO; it's classified as a cultural landscape (tangible heritage). Meskel festival and Gada system are both registered as intangible cultural heritage resources of Ethiopia.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is the difference between the benefits that the customer gains from owning or using a product and the costs of obtaining the product?
questions.explanation: Customer Value is defined as the difference between the benefits a customer receives from a product or service and the costs (monetary and non-monetary) of obtaining it. Customer satisfaction is the result of meeting or exceeding customer expectations, which is a different concept.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is an attraction available in a destination?
questions.explanation: Bale Mountains National Park is a natural attraction.

questions.questionText: Which goal pertains to the leadership role of a DMO?
options: Taking a leadership role in the tourism industry
questions.explanation: A Destination Management Organization (DMO) has the explicit goal of taking a leadership role in the tourism industry by coordinating stakeholders, developing strategies, and guiding the overall direction of tourism development in the destination.

questions.questionText: __________ are designed for clients who desire to travel independently. Most such tours consist of airfare, hotel accommodations, and either airport transfers or a car rental.
questions.explanation: Independent tour packages cater to clients who want to travel on their own.

questions.questionText: Which of the following are correct about travel Counsellor?
options: Provides all necessary information requested by prospective travelers
Recommends products and services best suited to the travelers' needs
Keep updated on new travel information and trends
questions.explanation: Travel Counsellors provide comprehensive support to travelers.

questions.questionText: Kejala is the tourist guide of Bale Mountain National Park, he facilitates a relationship between tourists and the Bale zone community/culture by providing information about Bale local customs, appropriate social behavior, and social norms. The role Kejala is:
questions.explanation: Kejala acts as a Cultural Host by bridging tourists and the local community.

questions.questionText: Why Become an Entrepreneur?
options: Desire to be their own boss
Desire to pursue their own ideas
questions.explanation: All listed reasons are motivations for becoming an entrepreneur.

questions.questionText: Which one is very important when choosing a destination during Event celebration?
options: An event may require a large volume of accommodation or particular specialist facilities that may only be available in particular destinations.
Events where social or partner programs are an important element may gravitate towards a place with many leisure attractions.
destination which is perceived as attractive may increase the number of participants who might take part in an event compared to if it had been held in a more 'attractive' location.
questions.explanation: Both options A and B are important considerations when choosing a destination for events: the availability of adequate accommodation and specialist facilities (A) and the presence of leisure attractions for social programs (B). The statement in option C contains a contradiction (comparing attractive to more attractive).

questions.questionText: Stakeholder collaboration is essential for effective tourism management. Which of the following is/are new product development process marketing manager deals with final decision about whether to launch the new product?
questions.explanation: Commercialization is the stage where the decision to launch a product is made.

questions.questionText: _____ is an activity initiated to create value by providing products and services: new (Creativity & Innovation) or already existing (replicating) to a market, fulfilling an unsatisfied demand.
questions.explanation: Entrepreneurship involves creating value through new or existing products.

questions.questionText: From the following statement all are true about food and Beverage Control System except:
options: The system neither cure nor prevent problems from occurring by itself.
An effective system is dependent on up-to-date policies and operational procedures.
The system could identify problems and trends in the business.
The system will not need management action to evaluate the information produced and to act upon it.
questions.explanation: Management action is necessary to evaluate and act on information from the system.

questions.questionText: Extravagant purchasing patterns can be a feature of skippers so the cashier must monitor the guest's account carefully, thus this activity takes place during____________?
questions.explanation: Monitoring for extravagant purchasing patterns that might indicate a potential 'skipper' (guest who intends to leave without paying) must occur during the guest's stay. This allows hotel staff to identify unusual patterns and take preventive measures before the guest attempts to leave without settling their bill.

questions.questionText: All of the following are management strategies for service businesses Except.
questions.explanation: While employee management is important for all businesses, it is not a specific service management strategy like the other options. The three primary service management strategies are tangibilizing the intangible service product, managing customer perceived risk, and managing service inconsistency.

questions.questionText: Provides a framework for organization to manage environmental impact.
questions.explanation: EMS (Environmental Management System) provides a framework for managing environmental impact.

questions.questionText: __________ sells tourist products directly to the public on behalf of the product suppliers and in return gets commission.
questions.explanation: Retail travel agencies sell directly to consumers and earn commissions.

questions.questionText: Assume that the hotel organization focuses on determining the needs and wants of target markets, and delivering the desired satisfaction more effectively and efficiently than competitors' to achieve their organizational goals. So what kind of marketing management philosophies the hotel organizations are adopted?
questions.explanation: The Marketing Concept focuses on understanding and meeting customer needs.

questions.questionText: Based on the level of satisfaction, which customers are willing to stay until something better comes along?
questions.explanation: Satisfied customers may remain until a better option is available.

questions.questionText: ____________ is one of the two highest expenses of any foodservice operation.
questions.explanation: Labor and food costs are typically the highest expenses in foodservice operations.

questions.questionText: Which of the following elements is typically included in the situation analysis of a tourist destination?
questions.explanation: Visitor demographics and market trends are crucial for situation analysis.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following statements is true about the Reservations Officer?
options: Place all required reservations with different suppliers
Follow up on reservations placed until confirmed
Relay all changes and confirmations to clients
questions.explanation: A Reservations Officer is responsible for both placing all required reservations with different suppliers (option A) and following up on those reservations until they are confirmed (option B).

questions.questionText: Among the Dimensions of Service Quality, which one is dealing with customer easily approaching the place of services offering and all about the ease to get the services?
questions.explanation: Accessibility refers to how easily customers can reach and use services.

questions.questionText: Which of the following factors is most crucial for effective tourist destination management?
questions.explanation: Collaboration with local communities is most crucial for effective destination management as it ensures sustainable tourism development, authentic experiences, local support for tourism initiatives, and equitable distribution of tourism benefits. While the other factors are important, they cannot succeed without local community engagement and support.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is true about the activity in Prepare and check logistical elements?
options: Check environmental considerations and decide on contingency plans
Check the brief with that of promoted to the tourist
Liaise with coach captain, retail store owners, tour operators, attraction staff
questions.explanation: All listed activities are part of preparing and checking logistical elements.

questions.questionText: Why are destinations considered complex phenomena to manage?
options: Due to conflicts between local and central government over tourism policy
Because destinations exist at different geographical levels
Because most destination management is in the hands of public sector agencies
Because the private sector owns and controls most tourism products
questions.explanation: Destinations are complex to manage because they exist at different geographical levels (local, regional, national), involve multiple stakeholders, and comprise various products and services offered by diverse providers.

questions.questionText: One of the following is not the strategic objectives for the world heritage site conservation?
options: Effective conservation of world heritage properties
Incredibility of the world heritage sites
Promote the development of effective capacity building measures
Increase public awareness and support through communication
questions.explanation: Incredibility is not a recognized strategic objective for conservation.

questions.questionText: From the following one is correct about credit control measures during check-in?
options: Collect pre-payments from walk-ins and non-guaranteed bookings
Asks for voucher and check what charges are covered
The room-service cashiers should immediately alert the credit department
Check whether the full account is to be settled by the company
questions.explanation: Collecting pre-payments is a standard credit control measure during check-in.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not included under hospitality and tourism service?
questions.explanation: All listed options are included under hospitality and tourism services.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following belongs to tangible immovable cultural resources?
questions.explanation: Buildings and palaces are tangible immovable cultural resources.

questions.questionText: According to Gunn and Var (2002), a tourism destination can be defined as:
options: Only capital cities and major towns
An area that is separately identified and promoted to tourists
questions.explanation: According to Gunn and Var (2002), a tourism destination is defined as an area that is separately identified and promoted to tourists as a place to visit, with tourism facilities and attractions that are designed to meet their needs. This definition emphasizes the intentional development and marketing aspects of destinations.

questions.questionText: Among the following, which is/are the common cause of problems of credit control in front office?
options: Unclear instructions to the guest at check-in
questions.explanation: All listed factors can lead to credit control problems.

questions.questionText: Among the following alternatives which is correct about credit control measures during occupancy?
options: Most transactions between a guest and a hotel take place
All guest accounts that are not settled by cash will be transferred to the city ledger
Last time that the guest will be physically accessible to the hotel
All procedures should be carefully followed up
questions.explanation: All procedures must be followed during occupancy for effective credit control.

questions.questionText: One is a type of hotel which is semi-luxurious or luxurious with exceptional comfort and decor?
questions.explanation: Luxury or deluxe hotels offer exceptional comfort and decor.

questions.questionText: One is a type of pleasure travelers who travel together on package tours and expenditure is very low?
questions.explanation: Group inclusive tours typically involve low expenditure for travelers.

questions.questionText: __________ is designed to directly advise tourists.
questions.explanation: Travel media is specifically designed to provide information to tourists.

questions.questionText: All are correct about convention but one.
options: Conventions are gatherings of people with common objectives
Trade and technical conventions are often held in conjunction with exhibitions.
Attendance is generally more than a hundred to 30,000.
questions.explanation: All statements about conventions are correct.

questions.questionText: One of the following departments is the department which is not visible to the guests and in aspects rooms before they are available for sale.
questions.explanation: The housekeeping department prepares rooms before they are available for sale.

questions.questionText: One is not the characteristic of tourists' destination.
options: It is providing integrated experience for the tourist
An area that is providing services for the tourist and people living on the spot
It is containing tourist attractions, products, services for spending at least one day
questions.explanation: All listed options are characteristics of a tourist destination.

questions.questionText: Phillip is a tour guide, he loves to tell stories of his home country to the 20 tourist clients from the US. His job description includes meeting the group upon arrival to the city, coordinating with the attraction that will be visited, planning what and where the tourists will have their meals, and arranging the hotel check-ins and check-outs of the tourists. What kind of guide is Phillip?
questions.explanation: Phillip is an urban guide as he coordinates city tours and attractions.

questions.questionText: From the following identify the wrong statement.
options: Brand mark is a part of a brand consisting of a word, letter, and group of words
Logo is a symbol made up of text and images that identifies a business
Trademark is a distinctive sign which identifies the goods and services of one company from those of another
questions.explanation: A brand mark is the visual or graphic element of a brand (like a symbol or design), not the textual elements. The textual elements (words, letters, names) are called brand names. Logos combine both visual and textual elements, and trademarks are legally protected brand elements.

questions.questionText: According to the United Nations World Tourism Organization (UNWTO), which of the following statements best describes a tourism destination?
options: place that offers a variety of tourism products and services
Any location visited by tourists, regardless of the duration of stay
physical location where tourists engage in recreational activities
An area promoted and marketed specifically to attract tourists
questions.explanation: According to the UNWTO, a tourism destination is primarily defined as a physical space that offers a variety of tourism products, services, and experiences under a brand or image. This comprehensive definition encompasses attractions, amenities, accessibility, human resources, image, and price - all essential components of a destination.

questions.questionText: One is not the advantage of Standard Recipes in food and beverage operation.
options: Consistency of quality, flavor, portion size
Preparation of correct number of items
questions.explanation: Standard recipes actually reduce the need for high supervision since they provide clear instructions that can be followed consistently by staff with different skill levels. The other options are all legitimate advantages of using standard recipes in food and beverage operations.

questions.questionText: A day-to-day management of the service is:
questions.explanation: Operational management involves the daily management of services.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is correct about the Characteristics of service which is the requirement that the customers to greater or lesser extent need to be present when the service is being performed?
questions.explanation: Inseparability refers to the characteristic of services where production and consumption occur simultaneously, requiring the customer's presence during service delivery. The other service characteristics are: intangibility (services cannot be touched), variability (services vary in quality), and perishability (services cannot be stored).

questions.questionText: A person who is a delegated representative of an entity that holds overall ultimate responsibility for the event is called___________.
questions.explanation: An Event Manager holds overall responsibility for the event.

questions.questionText: Identify the requirements for tourist destination management?
questions.explanation: All listed requirements are essential for effective destination management.

questions.questionText: One of the following statements is odd about the Pacific Asia Travel Association?
options: It was founded in 1951 as a nonprofit organization
The headquarter is located in Brussels, Belgium
questions.explanation: The Pacific Asia Travel Association (PATA) is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand, not Brussels, Belgium. Brussels is the headquarters of many European organizations, but not PATA.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following statements is incorrectly matched?
options: Visitor also called the audience for the event
Professional conferences Organizer (PEO) are any person, natural or juridical, who manages conventions and events
In the process of decision making implementing the solution is the critical step
questions.explanation: All statements are correctly matched.
